scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @vectis/web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @vectis/web exec tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @vectis/desktop exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps packages scripts convex tests
scripts.docs:build: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @vectis/web build && pnpm --filter @vectis/docs build
scripts.docs:deploy:dev: pnpm docs:build && pnpm --filter @vectis/docs exec wrangler deploy --env development
